context: Tests whether the agent produces a correct pre-merge checklist that matches the rapid-deploy skill's requirements for the Forge frontend-app. The PR in question introduces a new environment variable, so env-var handling is a key concern.

checklist.name: npm run build step
checklist.description: Includes a step that instructs running `npm run build` and verifying it exits 0 with no TypeScript errors before merging

checklist.name: Build failure blocks merge
checklist.description: Explicitly states that a failing build means the PR must NOT be merged (not just 'fix the errors')

checklist.name: Env vars in Vercel before merge
checklist.description: States that new environment variables must be added to Vercel project settings BEFORE merging (not after)

checklist.name: Vercel Production env vars
checklist.description: Specifies that environment variables must be set in Vercel → Environment Variables → Production

checklist.name: NEXT_PUBLIC keys mentioned
checklist.description: Mentions at least one of `NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` or `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_URL` as keys to verify in Vercel

checklist.name: .env.example update required
checklist.description: Flags that `.env.example` must be updated in the same PR when a new process.env.* reference is added

checklist.name: Console.log check command
checklist.description: Includes the git diff command to check for console.log/console.error additions: `git diff main...HEAD -- '*.tsx' '*.ts' | grep '^\+.*console\.'` or equivalent

checklist.name: Preview URL verification
checklist.description: Mentions that the Vercel bot posts a preview URL in the PR comments and that it must be tested before merging

checklist.name: Preview test checklist items
checklist.description: Includes at least 2 of the 4 specific preview checks: login works, dashboard loads/shows projects, project detail page opens, no browser console errors

checklist.name: Re-deploy preview after env fix
checklist.description: States that if a required env var is missing from Vercel, the preview should be re-deployed after adding it (before merging)

checklist.name: No extra general checks
checklist.description: Does NOT add a step requiring the agent to check code review approval, test suite results, or other checks not present in the skill
